create_MSAStatistics_from_chain_features: create MSAStatistics from chain features to compute sequence similarity and gap percentages for each MSA row
create_paired_features_across_chains: create paired MSA features across multiple protein chains by matching sequences from shared species
merge_chain_features_into_complex: merge features from multiple protein chains into a single FeatureDict for an entire complex
pair_sequences_across_chains: pair MSA sequences across chains by species and return indices of paired rows
deduplicate_unpaired_sequences: deduplicate unpaired MSA sequences that already exist in the paired MSA to remove redundancy
